attempts.sql: SELECT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id WHERE f.file_id = 'httpx/_client.py' AND s.kind = 'method' AND s.qualname LIKE 'Client.%' AND s.qualname NOT LIKE 'Client.%.%' AND (s.summary IS NULL OR s.summary = '') ORDER BY s.symbol_id
